scheme_name: Scheme to Provide Relief in Case of Death or Disability of Registered Building Workers
other_conditions: The applicant must be the nominee or dependent of the deceased construction worker.
The deceased construction worker must be registered with the Andhra Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
The construction worker must be registered under the Andhra Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board for permanent disability benefit.
The construction worker must be disabled to qualify for the permanent disability relief.
benefits_summary: Provides ₹5,00,000 for accidental death or permanent disability and ₹60,000 for natural death relief.
